AN HONOUR WE SHARE WITH YOU

Pride of
Punjab.

✦

With heartfelt gratitude to the esteemed jury and our cherished patrons for honouring us with the Pride of Punjab.

This recognition reflects generations of trust, love, and support for our authentic Punjabi flavours.

We also sincerely thank Punjab Tourism for this honour, which inspires us to proudly uphold our legacy and continue serving the true taste and spirit of Punjab with passion and dedication.
